blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines –Alas Pilipinas women’s team finished the Asian Games in high spirits, claiming ninth place with a 25-21, 25-9, 30-28 sweep of Hong Kong on Tuesday at Okazaki Chuo Sogo Park Gymnasium. The nationals achieved Japanese coach Taka Minowa’s goal after the team missed the quarterfinals, ending the tournament on a three-game winning streak. Bella Belen shone for the third straight game with 18 points off 16 kills, one block, and an ace laced with 10 digs.
